chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the hady (sacrificial animal) was identified and then was lost after that, then it has sufficed.

key_terms.أَجْزَأَ: it sufficed and fulfilled the obligation
key_terms.الْهَدْيِ: the sacrificial animal offered in hajj

ai.seo_question: If a hady sacrificial animal is identified and then gets lost, does it still count?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hady in hajj. If the sacrificial animal has already been properly identified and then goes missing afterward, the obligation is considered fulfilled.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3071 - Abdul Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"If the hady (sacrificial animal) was announced and then got lost afterward, it suffices."
